text:
jess_support: forwarding ticket from customer (ticket #78912) — they hit invalid JSON with response_format=structured & strict=true. repro attached.

sam_customer: reproducible with curl, shows HTML wrapper breaking strict parser. CURL + response below.

sam_customer: `curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?response_format=structured&strict=true" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`

sam_customer: response headers:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
X-Request-ID: req_abc123

sam_customer: response body starts with:
<!doctype html>
<html>...<script id="payload">{"choices":[{"text":"hello"}]}</script>...</html>

sam_customer: parser error: "Unexpected token < in JSON at position 0"

jess_support: odd — strict should reject if Content-Type != application/json. customer says Content-Type is wrong but status 200.

morgan_oncall: putting oncall hat — looks like edge/CDN injecting wrapper. can you reproduce bypassing Fastly? try curl to backend host: `https://internal-gen.redwood-internal/v1/generate` and include `-H 'Host: api.redwood.ai'`. also try `--http1.1`/`--raw`.

kai_eng: also check for nginx/fastly VCL rule that wraps health-check pages or error pages. sometimes a 200 gets content-type forced. @infra please check VCL for html_wrap rule.

jess_support: asked customer to run `curl -i -L --location-trusted --max-redirs 0` to see intermediate 302s. sam provided follow-up showing an upstream 302 to /maintenance.html then 200 with HTML wrapper while preserving 200 status. Included X-Edge-Server header `fastly-xyz`.

kai_eng: confirmed similarity to past bug where Fastly config served maintenance page with 200 and text/html. root cause: origin returned `X-Wrap-If` header and Fastly VCL added wrapper.

jess_support: immediate mitigation suggestions:
- ask customer to set `strict=false` or `response_format=plain` (works but not ideal)
- temporary require `Accept: application/json` + `X-Force-Content-Type: application/json` header (edge should respect but not guaranteed)
- infra to remove VCL rule or return 503 for maintenance pages

morgan_oncall: created infra ticket INF-4573 and assigned to infra-team. Action: audit Fastly VCL rules that set `content-type` or inject html wrappers when origin returns special header.

kai_eng: note for runtime: we should also validate on body start and return 502 if header mismatch to avoid silent HTML passing. Filing runtime issue RUNTIME-882.

sam_customer: thanks. will try workaround `strict=false` short-term. sharing X-Request-ID req_abc123 and full raw response in private.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: patch to edge disable-html-wrap rolled to canary at 2024-09-18T13:45:00Z :rocket: 

jess_support: marking customer notified, closing ticket once they confirm. :white_check_mark:
